question: For each department and material status, list the name of the department, the material status, the number of TIP materials associated with this department and status, the number of library materials associated with this department and status, the total number of TIP and library materials associated with this department and status. Include a subtotal for each department and a grand total across all departments.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tip_detail_enriched AS
SELECT
  td.tip_material_status_key AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
  td.subject_id AS SUBJECT_ID,
  td.term_code AS TERM_CODE,
  tso.offer_dept_name AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME
FROM beaver.tip_detail td
LEFT JOIN beaver.tip_subject_offered tso
  ON td.subject_id = tso.subject_id
 AND COALESCE(td.term_code,'') = COALESCE(tso.term_code,'')

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tip_counts AS
SELECT
  COALESCE(OFFER_DEPT_NAME, 'Unspecified Department') AS department_name,
  COALESCE(ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Unspecified Status') AS material_status,
  COUNT(*) AS tip_count
FROM tip_detail_enriched t
LEFT JOIN tip_material_status_lu ms
  ON t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY 1,2

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lib_counts AS
SELECT
  COALESCE(OFFER_DEPT_NAME, 'Unspecified Department') AS department_name,

FROM library_reserve_enriched l
LEFT JOIN library_material_status_lu ms
  ON l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY 1,2

  UNION ALL

  SELECT department_name, material_status,

  SELECT department_name, 'Subtotal' AS material_status,
         SUM(tip_count) AS tip_count,

         SUM(library_count) AS library_count,
